mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT DISTINCT m.perm FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perm IS NOT NULL AND m.perm <> '' AND m.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0
SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
